days.title: 棚田の村へ
days.morning: Drive ~4 h from Hanoi via Mai Chau to Pu Luong and check into a homestay.
days.afternoon: Walk the Don village terraces and watch the water wheels turn.
days.evening: Co Lung duck and bamboo rice in a stilt house.

days.title: コームオン村へトレッキング
days.morning: Trek through bamboo forest to the Thai village of Kho Muong.
days.afternoon: Explore Bang cave and swim in a clear stream.
days.evening: Water wheels creaking and stars over the valley.

days.title: ヒエウ滝と村
days.morning: Cycle to the multi-tiered Hieu waterfall for a swim.
days.afternoon: Visit Hieu village and its weavers; Pho Doan market on Saturdays.
days.evening: Rice wine through bamboo straws and bamboo dancing.

days.title: マー川ラフティング
days.morning: Bamboo rafting on the Ma river between cliffs.
days.afternoon: Relax at a homestay pool overlooking the paddies.
days.evening: BBQ hill chicken and stream fish.

days.title: マイチャウ – ハノイへ
days.morning: Early cloud-watching on Pu Luong peak.
days.afternoon: Lunch and brocade shopping in Mai Chau.
